title: James Beveridge and Jean White recorded their intention to marry
description: The 1888 printed transcription of Brunswick marriage intentions includes James Beveridge and Jean White of Georgetown under February 6, 1749. This documents an intention, not a marriage ceremony. Whether the pair are the already-profiled James Beveridge Jr. and Jean (McKinney) White is a research hypothesis rather than an authenticated identification; no person IDs are assigned to this event.
evidence_status: Dated 1749 intention appears in an 1888 historical transcription; actual 1749 manuscript and identity comparison pending

title: Henry T. Beverage and Ella Allen recorded in marriage index
description: A FamilySearch genealogy profile for Ella Allen cites Maine Marriage Index records identifying her marriage to Henry T. Beverage in Rockland on December 17, 1898. The record is an indexed original-reference lead, and the underlying marriage return has not yet been examined.
evidence_status: Indexed marriage record linked by FamilySearch; original civil register not inspected

title: Two Beverage students in North Haven's first high-school graduating class
description: The North Haven Historical Society identifies Elsie Beverage and Jennie Beverage among five students graduating in 1907 at Pulpit Harbor Church, in the town's first high-school graduation. These names are not automatically linked to similarly named profiles without additional records.
place: Pulpit Harbor Church, North Haven, Maine
evidence_status: Documented in North Haven Historical Society retrospective; original graduation list/photo pending

title: 1927 newspaper advertises Pulpit Harbor homestead auction by Frank Beverage
description: The Courier Gazette dated July 30, 1927 announces an August 24, 1927 public auction of the Sands H. Witherspoon homestead at Pulpit Harbor and names Frank Beverage as auctioneer. This is proof of an advertised event, NOT proof the sale occurred, proof of property ownership by Frank, or proof of which Frank Beverage it was.
evidence_status: Contemporary newspaper advertisement; auction outcome and Frank's identity unresolved

title: Town-deed discoveries help inspire North Haven Historical Society
description: A North Haven Historical Society history reprinting Lewis Haskell's February 1994 recollection says that on November 13, 1975, sixteen residents met to discuss a historical society after Sam Beverage, Lewis Haskell and other community members retrieved old documents and photographs from the town dump. The recovered materials included an original road map from Pulpit Harbor, bills for the first bridge, school lot deeds and other town records. The recovered originals are not reproduced on this website without permission.
evidence_status: Dated 1975 meeting in 1994 participant recollection hosted by local historical society; archives' current holdings to verify

title: Frank and May Beverage's golden wedding recorded in an island diary
description: Tonny Calderwood recorded attending the 50th anniversary celebration of 'Uncle Frank' and 'Aunt May' on October 15, 1937, with approximately 25 guests. The transcribed diary also preserves wording from the back of a photograph identifying Mr. and Mrs. Frank Beverage at their golden wedding. The photo image is not part of this repository, and whether this Frank was the site's Frank Beverage (born 1861) still requires the couple's 1887 marriage record. The copyright holders require permission for excerpts or images.
evidence_status: Contemporaneous 1937 diary and photo-back caption transcribed by NHHS; identity with site's 1861 Frank remains a hypothesis

title: Calderwood family research passed to a Samuel Beverage
description: On June 23, 1967, Tonny Calderwood recorded writing to Samuel Beverage with more family information, following a March 11 diary entry about a letter from Sammy Beverage requesting Calderwood material. These first-person notes document personal genealogy research on North Haven. It is plausible but not yet separately proved that this correspondent was Samuel Hiram Beverage, born in 1917, so no person ID is assigned.
evidence_status: Contemporary diary identifies Samuel Beverage by name; identity with existing profile not established
